name: Arcanum Lookout
title: Arcanum Lookout
summary: A floating octagonal platform (24 m, z 25.8-30) 26 m above the eastern edge of the Graveyard (65.3S 43.3W), reached by the Up to Arcanum Lookout portal on the ground beneath it (Down to Surface portal on the deck); acpedia lists four NPCs on it. The Graveyard's tombstones, candle shrines and Massilor's Crypt portal spread to the west.
routeNote: Moved from candeth-keep -> qalabar to wai-jhou -> candeth-keep to cut with Knathtead Excavation and Burning Wood (same Graveyard valley); insert cost 2.71 km vs 2.05 km for the given slot (teleport hops, so the extra 0.66 km is free on the shoot).

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 42 m south-south-west of the floating platform, from beside the ground portal to 10 m above its deck; nothing within 30 m.
shots.notes: Vertical boom 42 m south-south-west of the floating platform: from beside the Up to Arcanum Lookout portal on the ground, rising past the platform's rim to 10 m above its deck, the Graveyard spreading behind; sun behind.
